prompt: Your coach criticises your performance sharply after a match and you feel stung. Once you have cooled down, what is the most growth-focused next step?

options.text: Leave the team to avoid being criticised again
Decide the coach is always wrong about you
Ignore everything that was said because the tone was harsh
Pick out one specific, useful point from the feedback and ask for an example of what doing it well looks like

explanation: Harsh delivery can hide a usable point. Extracting one specific thing to work on, and asking what good looks like, turns an unpleasant moment into a clear next practice target.
